registers.label: Spare
lines: The people who sat in darkness have seen a great light.
The Lord is my light and my salvation.
By the sea he called them: Follow me.
And they left their nets at once.
The kingdom of heaven has come near.
We turn, and we follow.
Come, let us worship the Light who calls us.
We will follow. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Dawn comes up grey over the lake, and into a land that has sat a long time in the dark, a great light is breaking.
The Lord is my light and my salvation.
A man walks the shoreline and stops where the fishermen are working, and he says two words that change a life: follow me.
The Lord is my light and my salvation.
And they do — nets still wet in their hands, the boat left rocking, the old life dropped on the sand.
The Lord is my light and my salvation.
Whom shall we fear, then, with that light on the water and that voice calling our name?
The Lord is my light and my salvation. Thanks be to God!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: A great light dawns on the people in the dark.

The Lord is my light and my salvation.
They leave the nets behind and follow him.
